_comment: CAVE BIOME DEPTH BANDING. Vanilla registers surface biomes at depth point(0.0) AND point(1.0), deep_dark at point(1.1), and the dedicated underground biomes (dripstone_caves, lush_caves) across span(0.2, 0.9); selection is NEAREST box. The terrain's depth runs far past vanilla's range in this deep world, so read raw it pins whole columns nearer deep_dark's 1.1 than anything else and the 0.2-0.9 window is unreachable. This scales terra_continental:depth by terra_continental:cave_depth_scale (0.42 by default; vanilla's depth is linear in Y too) so the underground bands are reachable, then caps it with min(): 0.8 above y=32, so the deep interiors of very tall terrain don't read as deep_dark, and 1.6 below, bounding the deep_dark band at the floor. The scale's settings are [caves] in terra_continental-common.toml. Biome selection only: initial_density_without_jaggedness, sloped_cheese and factor read terra_continental:depth directly, and nothing but the noise_settings router reads this file.
